name: Game Engine & Rules
description: The Pacman simulation core: the generic Game loop and Agent interface in game.py, plus pacman.py's GameState, win/lose and movement rules, and the command-line entry point that wires layouts, agents, and displays together.

name: Shared Foundation
description: Foundational support code every other module depends on: util.py's search data structures (Stack, Queue, PriorityQueue, Counter), probability and timeout helpers, and layout.py's .lay maze parsing and layout lookup.

name: Adversarial Search Agents
description: The student implementation surface for the multi-agent search assignment: ReflexAgent, the MultiAgentSearchAgent base class, and the Minimax, Alpha-Beta, and Expectimax agents with their evaluation functions in multiAgents.py.

name: Agent Policies & Controls
description: Alternative agent implementations loaded at runtime by name: baseline greedy and left-turning Pacman agents, the random and Pacman-seeking DirectionalGhost policies, and the keyboard-driven human agents.

name: Project Metadata & Configuration
description: Course-harness metadata rather than runtime logic: projectParams.py's autograder settings (student file, test class, bonus flags) and the VERSION release stamp for the CS188 project.
